mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the constitutional status and appointment cycle of the Finance Commission?
options: It is a constitutional body under Article 280, appointed by the President every 5 years
It is a constitutional body under Article 280, appointed by the President at irregular intervals
It is a statutory body under Article 280, appointed by the President every 5 years
It is a constitutional body under Article 280, appointed by the President only once
mcqs.explanation: The Finance Commission is a constitutional body established under Article 280 and is appointed by the President every 5 years. The other options incorrectly alter its statutory status or appointment cycle.

mcqs.keyword: State share under the 16th Finance Commission
mcqs.question: What share was allocated to Telangana under the 16th Finance Commission?
mcqs.explanation: Telangana’s share under the 16th Finance Commission was 2.17%. The figures 2.174%, 2.147% and 4.217% refer to other reported values and are not the stated share in this fact.
